# Shepherd of Hermas Chapter 54 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic Equivalence)

**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** P.Mich. 130, Shepherd of Hermas 54 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/SHE_054_page_001.jpg

---

## Similitude 5, Introduction — What Real Fasting Looks Like

**54:1** I was fasting and sitting on a hill, giving thanks to the Lord for everything he had done for me, when the Shepherd came and sat beside me. "Why are you out here so early?" he asked. "Lord," I said, "I have a religious duty to observe." "What duty?" he asked. "I'm keeping a fast, lord," I said. "And what kind of fast are you keeping?" he asked.

**54:2** "The traditional kind, lord," I said. "You don't actually know how to fast to the Lord," he said. "This empty fast you're performing before him — it's not a real fast." "Why not, lord?" I asked. "I'm telling you," he said, "what you think is a fast is not a fast. But let me explain what a complete, truly acceptable fast looks like.

**54:3** "Listen," he said. "God has no interest in an empty fast like that. Fasting that way achieves absolutely nothing righteous before him. Here is the fast God wants: do no evil in your life. Serve the Lord with a pure heart. Keep his commandments and live by his ordinances. Don't let evil desire arise in your heart. Trust God. If you do these things — if you fear him and stay away from every evil action — you will truly live for God. And if you do these things, you will have accomplished a great fast, one that is genuinely pleasing to God."

---

*PNEUMA renders for contemporary clarity and accessibility, capturing Hermas's prophetic challenge to external fasting practice.*
